# NSE equity-segment full-day trading holidays, calendar year 2026 (IST YYYY-MM-DD).
# Weekday closures only — weekend-dated holidays (Maha Shivaratri 02-15 Sun,
# Id-Ul-Fitr 03-21 Sat, Independence Day 08-15 Sat) need no entry; 2026-11-08
# (Sun) is Diwali Laxmi Pujan with a Muhurat session, not a weekday closure.
# Sources: NSE circular CMTR71775, cross-checked against Zerodha and Groww
# holiday calendars on 2026-09-14. Paste the comma list into MARKET_HOLIDAYS
# (/etc/pm/backend.env) and PM_HOLIDAYS (/etc/pm/strategy.env). Refresh every
# December when NSE publishes the next year's list — and on any special
# closure circular (elections, etc.).
